sourceHashScope: Application/build inputs and test sources; identity is not feature coverage.

load.scope: Synthetic native SQL Store pipeline, including global application lock. No HTTP/browser or production p95/capacity claim.

contention.scope: Synthetic native Store/changeAndView pipeline. No HTTP/browser/WAN, SQL execution plans/IO, production load or service capacity claim. Uses unchanged production lock and validation rules. Profile instrumentation adds timing SELECT and memory sampling overhead.

metricNotes.percentiles: Nearest-rank sample quantiles, not production p95/p99 estimates. Count is explicit; mixed groups have fewer observations.
metricNotes.queueMs: Time before the bounded benchmark worker starts; not application admission queue latency.
metricNotes.transactionEntryMs: Client time from transaction call to callback; includes pool/begin, application-lock acquisition and round trips.
metricNotes.lockAcquireServerMs: SQL server clock around sp_getapplock, including procedure execution cost. Not pure DMV lock wait or client/pool time.
metricNotes.elapsedMs: Store operation until returned view/delta. JSON encode measured separately; assertions are excluded.
metricNotes.stages: Read/persist/project durations include their SQL calls and overlap sqlMs; do not sum all metrics. CommandAndValidationAndDiffPrep covers the copy-to-persist gap, including command execution, schema validation and preparation; it does not isolate schema validation. Owned planning callbacks keep their identity during profiling.
metricNotes.memoryBytes: Whole Node process samples during each case and stage boundaries. Includes retained fixture/base, instrumentation and response data; no per-request allocation or guaranteed CPU-bound peak.
